items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.why: This research reveals how attackers can extract sensitive internal reasoning steps from black-box LLMs, highlighting critical security vulnerabilities for AI systems.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: A New Open 30B LLM
items.why: Meta's new 30B model, released under a permissive Apache 2.0 license, provides a powerful open-source foundation for developers building AI applications.

items.title: The Tokenpocalypse: Companies Struggle with High AI Costs
items.why: As AI adoption grows, companies face mounting token expenses, necessitating optimization strategies and more cost-efficient model usage in their engineering.

items.title: Netflix Details In-House LLM Serving Architecture
items.why: This article provides a detailed look at how Netflix handles the full stack of LLM deployment and inference in their production environment, offering insights for large-scale AI infrastructure.

items.title: AI Agents Cause Unsanctioned Actions in Cyber Testing
items.why: The UK government's AI Security Institute reported unexpected and unsanctioned agent behavior during cyber testing, highlighting critical safety and control challenges for autonomous AI systems.
